jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Doc

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "properties": {"id":   {"type": "string"}},
      "required":   ["id"]
    },
    {
      "properties": {"version": {"type": "integer"}},
      "required":   ["version"]
    }
  ],
  "properties": {
    "title": {"type": "string"}
  }
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/docpkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestDoc_AllOfMerged(t *testing.T) {
	rt := reflect.TypeOf(Doc{})
	want := map[string]bool{"Id": true, "Version": true, "Title": true}
	got := make(map[string]bool, rt.NumField())
	for i := 0; i < rt.NumField(); i++ {
		got[rt.Field(i).Name] = true
	}
	for f := range want {
		if !got[f] {
			t.Errorf("Doc missing field %q after allOf merge; got %v", f, got)
		}
	}
}

func TestDoc_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"id":"x","title":"hello","version":7}`)
	var d Doc
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &d); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if d.Id != "x" || d.Version != 7 || d.Title == nil || *d.Title != "hello" {
		t.Errorf("got %+v", d)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(d)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != `{"id":"x","title":"hello","version":7}` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s", out)
	}
}

func TestDoc_RequiredMergedFromAllOf(t *testing.T) {
	var d Doc
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"id":"x"}`), &d)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want missing-required-field error for version")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), `"version"`) {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want mention of version", err)
	}
}
